description: Should worker PR merge go-aheads sit on your board?

annotations.description: Strike 6c6d8b4b (judge, not in your words): a245 'merge cgroups#4 (Jan approved, green)?' went on your board at 10:02Z through a raw task modify, which skips the PR-row guard in __tw.sh (2581774). Family fixed four times this week, so no fifth fix without you. Two readings: a real go-ahead for the worker to merge, or PR work pr-watch already carries. Options: (a) merge go-aheads stay off your board and the worker merges once approved and green; (b) they stay on your board as decisions; (c) block raw task writes in Gordon's pane so the guard always runs. Reply fc0f a, b or c.
Piotr 11:12: "fc0f c: yeah sure, I don't fully understand the impact but those decisions are too low level for me". Option c taken; reflect worker implementing.

Offer to Piotr 11:14: reply "only fc0f" and Gordon returns 8777, 3bdd, 6da1, b39e, 0163 to his board and keeps the old repeat-to-board rule (local commits, revertible). His 11:13 "we shall see" left the broad reading standing.
